meta.name: gstack-design-consultation
meta.description: GStack design consultation method for critiquing product/UI/visual direction, exploring alternatives, and recommending a design path before production.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评审产品设计方向，探索替代方案并推荐最佳路径
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要专业的设计评审和方向建议
copy.tagline_en: Review product design direction, explore alternatives, and recommend the best path
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need professional design critique and direction advice

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会先阅读相关文档，然后给出产品/UI/视觉方向的批评、替代方案、约束条件、推荐方案和下一步制作计划。
howto.when: 当视觉方向未定、UI/PPT 需要评审，或你明确说出“$gstack-design-consultation”时触发。

say.text: 帮我评审这个UI设计，给出批评和替代方案。
say.note: Claude 会按方法输出评审结果。

say.text: 使用 $gstack-design-consultation 分析这个视觉方向。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude reads relevant docs, then produces critique, alternatives, constraints, recommendation, and next artifact plan for product/UI/visual direction.
howto.when_en: Triggered when visual direction is unsettled, UI/PPT needs critique, or user explicitly says "$gstack-design-consultation".

say_en.text: Review this UI design and give critique and alternatives.
say_en.note: Claude will output review per method.

say_en.text: Use $gstack-design-consultation to analyze this visual direction.
